Name: HD Witch and Henchman with Cute Krobus Anime Portraits
Author: CrypticHaze
Description: I was Inspired by Hazel - The Romanceable Witch NPC and Harvest Moon Witch Princess Mod to make new portraits for the Bog Witch. I also included my Krobus portrait, all the portraits are individually selectable from Generic Mod Config Menu. I made it compatible with Hazel - The Romanceable Witch NPC so when she is cured the correct pictures will be displayed, also compatible with Anime HD Portraits, etc. Requires  Portraiture, Content Patcher and I highly recommend using Generic Mod Config Menu.

Downloads.Description: Krobus, Witch, and Henchman selectable from Generic Config Mod Menu or config.json with Notepad++
